jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Whippy is leading the way in AI-powered business communication, transforming how companies engage with customers using intelligent AI Agents. From customer support to marketing to sales, businesses rely on Whippy’s Voice AI and Chat AI to eliminate manual workflows—responding to inquiries, nurturing leads, screening job applicants, and automating high-value interactions at scale. By combining AI-driven messaging with omni-channel automation, Whippy replaces outdated tools with a single, powerful platform that helps businesses work smarter, faster, and more efficiently.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager at Whippy, you will:

Start by spending at least one-third of your time coding and building new product.

Over time, you will work with the CTO to manage and scale our engineering team and best practices. Somethings you should have experience doing are.

  • Working and communicating with a team in a remote environment.

  • Conduct regular 1-1s and help unblock engineers as needed.

  • Help to manage a hiring pipeline and conduct technical interviews.

  • Conduct code reviews and aid engineers in releasing new features quickly and reliably.

About you

1+ years of experience as an engineering manager at a start-up in a remote engineering team environment.

A desire to be a part of the entire project development process. From research gathering and planning to implementation and monitoring.

Great written and verbal communication skills for expressing ideas, designs, and potential solutions in a mostly asynchronous manner.

What do we offer?

Compensation is $80K-$100K/year based on experience

Opportunity to take on significant responsibility and ownership in a highly disruptive product.

Working hands-on with serial entrepreneurs who have created $100M+ valued companies

What to know?

To provide transparency, here are some important points to note about the position:

  • We are a startup, and our team dynamics differ from those of companies in different sizes and stages. Our team is distributed across the globe, and this distributed nature will continue to grow. This means that there is always something happening, so effective time management in a remote and asynchronous engineering environment is essential.

  • While English is the second language for many engineers on the team, fluency in written English is a requirement. While fluency in spoken English is also a plus, if you are not confident in your written English ability, please do not apply.

  • We hire globally regardless of timezone, but we have team meetings on Mondays and Fridays at 2:30 pm GMT. If you are unable to be online during these hours, please do not apply.

  • Pay is determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: interviews and an assessment of several factors that are unique to each candidate, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, and the abilities of the candidate.

What’s the process?

Here's the entire process if selected after a CV screen.

  1. Submit your Resume or CV

  2. Video call to talk about your experience and the role.

  3. Meet the team and review work.

  4. Full Time Position Offer extended.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

Location: Dublin, Ireland, on-site
Requirement: Degree in Maths, Engineering or Computer Science (completed or final year)

About Whippy

Whippy is an AI-powered communication platform that automates real business workflows across voice, SMS, chat, and APIs.

We integrate with telephony providers, CRMs, ATS platforms, and internal enterprise systems to power AI agents that handle inbound calls, qualification flows, onboarding processes, support queries, and operational tasks.

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineering Intern, you will work inside real enterprise deployments and ship production code that connects Whippy to customer systems.

You will operate at the intersection of APIs, telephony, databases, and AI workflows. This is not a research role and not a shadowing internship. You will build and debug real systems used by live customers.

This internship is designed as a pathway to a full-time Forward Deployed Engineer role.

What You’ll Do

• Build and extend API integrations with third-party systems (CRM, ATS, telephony, internal tools)
• Implement data flows between Whippy and external platforms
• Debug production issues involving webhooks, retries, and async workflows
• Improve logging, monitoring, and visibility across deployment systems
• Document integration architecture and deployment patterns
• Identify patterns across customer implementations and propose reusable improvements

What We’re Looking For

• Degree in Mathematics, Engineering, or Computer Science (completed or final year)
• Strong fundamentals in programming
• Experience building non-trivial software projects (internships, open source, side projects)
• Comfort working with APIs and relational databases
• Ability to reason clearly about data flow and failure modes
• Strong ownership mindset and willingness to debug real production issues, communicate clearly in writing and verbally

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Hybrid Buenos Aires, remote LATAM, or remote US)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hi, I'm Joe, Head of Customer Success at Whippy. I'm hiring an entrepreneurial CSM to retain and grow a dedicated book of customers.

Why I'm hiring

At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers - that's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, Ai-agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1000+ businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding/implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

Our best CSMs have taken our staffing customers from an initial $12k deal to $180k ARR because customers like Your Employment Solutions are getting over $1M in ROI using Whippy to augment their teams and beat the competition.

 

You'll help us grow more customers by deeply understanding their desired outcomes, helping them achieve those outcomes, and providing an exceptional experience along the way.

 

This is one of those rare jobs with massive growth and learning opportunities: there's no bureaucracy here, and we're still early in building a world-class customer success team. You'll have a crucial role to play, and fresh ideas, feedback, and experimentation are always encouraged because we double down on wins and quickly pivot when ideas don't work out.

You'll work with six other CSMs and report directly to me, and I'll provide the support, coaching, tools, and data to do the best work of your career here, plus the variable comp to get well rewarded when you deliver results.

 

I'm looking for a CSM that wants to grow into a renaissance CSM, someone technical, strategic, and commercial, all in one: Technical as in you enjoy mastering the product and finding the best solutions for our customers. Strategic as in you deeply understand your customers pain points and always have a plan to solve them. Commercial as in you have pricing awareness and understand the retention and expansion risks and opportunities in your book.

 

Some things you'll do

  • Own a book of business end to end, from onboarding through renewal and expansion, as the single point of contact and trusted advisor.

  • Own your gross and net revenue retention, and get rewarded for beating targets.

  • Run a proactive cadence on every account: prepared calls, clear agendas, mutual success plans, and follow-through.

  • Become a product and customer expert. Master Whippy’s products and know your customers' business well enough to build the workflows, AI agents, and automations that solve their problems.

  • Tie usage to business outcomes, and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.

  • Turn wins into case studies, references, and testimonials that help sales win the next customer.

  • Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

  • Tell customers the truth, steering them away from work that won't move their business and toward the work that will.

  • Advocate for the customer. Feed what you hear to product, sales, and engineering so we build the right things.

  • Experiment and iterate. If you have an idea to do something better, do it and document what you learn.

Our customer success values

This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach & support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:

  • Everyone is a builder. Our CSMs build in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.

  • We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.

  • We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.

  • CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

What we're looking for

  • Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.

  • Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.

  • Comfortable getting technical. You don't need to code, but you're the kind of person who enjoys taking a tool apart, figuring out how it works, and building something useful with it.

  • Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.

  • Opinionated about customer experience. Good strategic advice needs well-formed views, so have them.

  • Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

  • Ideally 2+ years in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management) at a technical SaaS product. That's the preferred path, but if you have an unconventional work history and can articulate how that'll help you succeed in this role, I welcome you to apply

  • Fluent written and spoken English required. Able to work US Eastern hours (work starts at 8am)

You'll thrive here if...

  • You're technical and love to build.

  • You're entrepreneurial. You treat your accounts like your own business and get energy from building from scratch.

  • You're a consultative problem solver. You dig into the why behind what a customer asks and recommend the right solution, even when it's not the one they came in asking for.

  • This sounds like fun to you: a customer wants to launch a complex, time-sensitive campaign across calls and texts, isn't sure how to structure it, and their team is stretched thin. You roll up your sleeves, map their goal to the product, and build it with them.

  • You thrive in a fast, evolving startup and you're excited to help build a customer success program from the ground up.

About Whippy

Whippy is a communication, automation, and AI agent platform. You reach customers across calls, texts, and email, at scale through personalized blasts and automated drips, with every message landing in one shared inbox. Replies get auto-assigned to a teammate, picked up by an AI agent, or carried forward by an automation. Once a conversation wraps, Whippy pushes the data you care about back into your systems in the exact format you need. It's true two-way dialogue on every channel that cuts the repetitive work and frees teams to focus on the human work that drives revenue, without adding headcount.

We're industry agnostic, with our biggest wins so far in staffing, healthcare, and other in-person businesses going through digital transformations. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with over 1,000 businesses using Whippy worldwide. In staffing alone, we've helped firms cut screening costs by 95% and save over a million dollars a year.

Whippy was founded in 2021 by CEO David Daneshgar and CTO Jack Kennedy. Jack is an engineering machine and a marathon runner. David started BloomNation in 2011 after winning $27,205 in a poker tournament, grew it into a platform generating billions in sales for florists, then left to build something bigger with Jack.

Location

Candidates based in Buenos Aires, Argentina are strongly preferred as we have a WeWork office in Vicente Lopez and are building toward an in-person team culture. Open to strong candidates anywhere in Latin America or U.S. EST hours required. Full English fluency required.

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses, WeWork membership, and more.

Hiring Process:

  1. You submit your application and I'll review it.

  2. A 45 minute call with me for us to get to know each other better.

  3. You’ll receive a take-home assignment that will assess your technical and strategic skills. The assignment will be presented to me in an hour call. This is your chance to showcase your skills.

  4. A 30 minute call with our CEO, David

  5. A 30 minute call with our CTO, Jack

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist (LATAM Only)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Customer Support Specialist (LATAM, Remote)

About Whippy

Whippy is a fast-growing AI communication platform helping some of the largest staffing and workforce companies in the United States replace manual workflows with intelligent AI agents across voice, SMS, chat, and automation. We are at $6M ARR, bootstrapped, and scaling fast.

Read this before applying.

This is NOT a help desk role. It is NOT a BPO role. It is NOT a ticket queue. If your most recent role was at Teleperformance, Concentrix, Sutherland, or any scripted support environment, do not apply. This is a technical, fast-paced, customer-facing role with a 2-minute response SLA and real diagnostic work every day.

Understanding where this role fits.

At Whippy, our CSMs handle accounts with deep API integrations. Customer Support Specialists handle a different but equally important segment — customers who run their operations through workflow automation rather than custom API integrations. You will be configuring, building, and troubleshooting automated workflows using Whippy's internal workflow builder and no-code tools like Zapier. You do not need to write code, but you MUST think like an operator who understands how automated workflows are built, how they break, and how to fix them.

What You Will Do

  • Respond to customer issues via Intercom with a 2-minute response SLA on chat

  • Diagnose and resolve workflow misconfigurations, campaign errors, carrier issues, and compliance rejections

  • Build and troubleshoot automated workflows using Whippy's internal workflow builder and Zapier

  • Proactively monitor customer usage and reach out before customers report problems

  • Log bugs in Linear with full documentation and follow through to resolution

  • Coordinate directly with telephony providers like Telnyx, Bandwidth, and Twilio when needed

  • Manage a portfolio of non-dedicated accounts with both reactive and proactive touchpoints

  • Document solutions and share playbooks with the broader support team

What We Are Looking For

  • Real SaaS support experience, not BPO, not scripted, not call center

  • Comfort building and troubleshooting automated workflows using Zapier, Make, or similar no-code tools. This is the most important technical differentiator for this role

  • Proactive instinct, you notice usage drops, workflow gaps, and quiet customers before they tell you something is wrong

  • Ability to manage multiple open conversations simultaneously under a 2-minute SLA

  • Strong written English, fast, clear, and professional

  • Comfortable on Zoom sharing your screen and walking customers through fixes

  • Ambition to grow into CSM, product, or marketing over time

Location

Buenos Aires, Argentina strongly preferred. This role is hybrid 3 days per week at our WeWork office in Vicente Lopez. Other LATAM locations will be considered for exceptional candidates. EST hours required. Full English fluency required.

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses, WeWork membership, and more.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Account Executive at Whippy

Remote (East Coast mornings)

180-200K OTE (50/50 split), uncapped above quota.

Top performers will earn $300K+. We pay for production, not tenure.

Over the last 90 days, our founder led sales motion booked nearly $1M in ARR across new customers and expansion.

The opportunity is proven. The sales organization is not finished.

We are looking for an exceptional Account Executive who can build their own pipeline, think strategically about their territory and deals, and help us shape the sales organization that comes next. This is not a role where a sales manager tells you what to do every morning. When you see an open lane, we expect you to run with it.

 

Why Whippy

Whippy is the AI native platform for business communication: AI Voice Agents, AI Recruiting, messaging, VoIP, deep integrations, and our own workflow engine in one system. Our customers do not buy software that helps their employees do the work. They buy AI that does the work.

Our deepest market today is staffing and HR, where we are the category leader, and new verticals are already opening behind it. We serve more than 1,000 customers, with an engineering team larger than the rest of the company combined. Customers like Your Employment Solutions and Staffworks have each generated more than $1M in measurable value using Whippy, and those are named, public case studies you get to sell with.

It is common to land a $50K ARR customer and expand that relationship by another $100K or more over time.

How we work

Bootstrapped and profitable, so revenue is the strategy, and your commission comes from customers, not a burn rate.

Leadership stays close to the pipeline. Our CEO still cold calls, so you'll never be selling in a vacuum.

AI first in how we sell, not just what we sell. We expect you to use AI to move faster in prospecting, prep, and follow up.

Speed over polish. Results over activity.

The job

You own the entire cycle: sourcing, discovery, demo, business case, negotiation, close, and the expansion inside the account after. You build pipeline through outbound, referrals, partners, conferences, and your own relationships.

You work directly with our CEO on deals, territory strategy, and how we scale the sales organization. You work directly with engineering, because customer feedback here does not disappear into a ticketing system. It shapes what gets built next.

There are no SDRs filling your calendar, no manager checking your activities, and no rigid playbook. You inherit a product customers want, active pipeline, and proof the motion works. Some people read that as risk. You should read it as freedom.

Remote role. Our customers run on East Coast time, so your mornings do too. If you can own the 8am ET calling block, we do not care what time zone you sleep in.



We expect you to operate independently

You will have clear revenue expectations, deal qualification criteria, and regular pipeline and deal reviews with the CEO. Within that structure, we expect you to decide where your time is best spent, know which deals are real and which are wasting your time, and pressure test your own pipeline. Ask for help before a deal needs rescuing, and come with a point of view rather than waiting for instructions. If something in our sales process is broken, notice it and help us make it better.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you show us a target list we did not give you.

  • First 90 days: you are running complete cycles independently and closing your first deals.

  • Year one at plan: $1M+ in new ARR closed. Beat plan, and $300K+ is real math, not a recruiting line.

  • Perform, and you help pick the next AE and shape the team that follows.

Who succeeds here

You have personally closed meaningful B2B software revenue and can explain exactly how you created and won those deals. Your buyer has been the owner, executive, or operator who signs the check and only responds to measurable ROI. You get prospects to calculate their own ROI out loud, you book the next meeting before ending the current one, and you would rather pick up the phone or get on a plane than send a fourth follow up email.

If you have sold into staffing or HR technology, that is valuable, because you may already know many of our buyers. It is not a requirement. What matters is that you know how to sell to skeptical, fast moving operators.

This is not for you if

  • You want leads handed to you or a manager telling you what to prioritize.

  • You need every process documented before taking action.

  • You want to sell one simple product the same way every day.

  • You cannot consistently work East Coast mornings.

Why join now

You are not joining a company trying to figure out whether customers will buy. They already are. You are also not joining a mature sales organization where every decision has been made. It has not.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Solutions Engineer at Whippy
Remote, United States, with travel to industry shows and customer sites (roughly 20 to 30 percent)

Total Comp: $120,000-$180,000 depending on experience & location

Whippy sells a deeply technical product into a non technical industry. Every serious deal involves an ATS integration, telephony architecture, AI agents, and workflow automation. Today, that technical depth in the sales cycle comes from our founders. One of our largest prospects described why it works: our CTO came in as an engineer giving a solution, not a salesperson giving a pitch. Buyers drop their guard for engineers.

This role exists so that credibility scales beyond the founders. Your mission: make complex Whippy deployments provable in pre sales and repeatable in post sales.

Why Whippy

Whippy is the AI native platform for business communication: AI Voice Agents, AI Recruiting, messaging, VoIP, deep integrations, and our own workflow engine in one system. Our customers do not buy software that helps their employees do the work. They buy AI that does the work.

Our deepest market today is staffing and HR, where we are the category leader, and new verticals are already opening behind it. We serve more than 1,000 customers, with an engineering team larger than the rest of the company combined. Our enterprise pipeline includes multi hundred branch companies deploying AI agents across their entire footprint. The deals are here. The person who makes them technically real is you.

How we work

Bootstrapped and profitable, so revenue is the strategy. No task is above or beneath anyone here, including the CEO, who still cold calls, and the CTO, who still runs demos. AI first in how we work, not just what we sell. Speed over polish. Results over activity.

The job, pre sales

You design the solution on complex deals: which products, how they connect to the prospect's ATS, what writes back, and what the rollout across branches looks like. You own the technical deep dive call, the meeting where the prospect brings their IT admin, and you answer definitively. A confident "no, but here is the workaround" builds more trust than a guessed yes.

You carry encyclopedic knowledge of our major integrations. You build prospect specific sandboxes and working AI agents for proof. You own RFPs and security reviews end to end so the AEs stay selling. You travel with the sales team as the technical face of Whippy at industry shows and enterprise on sites, because the biggest deals are won in rooms, not inboxes.

The demo environment that can never fail is your personal SLA.

The job, post sales

You design deployment architecture for enterprise accounts and hand healthy, fully documented implementations to Customer Success. You take the technical escalations that go beyond standard support. And you build the pattern library: every solved deployment becomes a documented, reusable playbook, so the next account starts from a pattern instead of a blank page and the whole team levels up on your work.

You also own the feedback loop to engineering: what we lose deals on, what every prospect asks for, where competitors exploit gaps.

Where the line sits

The AE always runs discovery, always runs the first demo, always owns pricing and the close. You never join a first call. You join when a technical evaluator is joining the next meeting, when the solution needs custom architecture, when a proof of concept needs building, or when an integration question has stumped the AE twice. If a deal arrives without a completed discovery brief, you send it back. This role is a weapon the AEs deploy, not a crutch they lean on.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you can run our standard demo solo and have shadowed every active enterprise deal.

  • First 90 days: you own the technical calls on live deals and have shipped the first three playbooks in the pattern library.

  • Year one: you own the technical motion on every enterprise deal, the pattern library covers our top ten deployment types, and the founders have not run a scoping call in six months.

Who succeeds here

You have spent at least 3+ years in customer facing pre sales roles, as an SE, Solutions Consultant, or senior Sales Engineer, in staffing technology, ATS ecosystems, or CCaaS and business telephony. You do not write production code, but you read API docs fluently, test endpoints without an engineer, and can debug an integration live on a call. You have built or configured AI agents or IVR flows, you can run a technical demo solo under hostile questioning, and you write documentation people actually use. You explain architecture in plain English to a business owner and hold your own with their IT team in the same meeting. You get genuine satisfaction from making the deal work, not from being the hero of the room.

This is not for you if

  • You need a solved problem handed to you with a runbook.

  • You want to stay behind the scenes. This role is customer facing every week.

  • You see documentation as someone else's job.

  • You cannot travel to shows and customer sites.

Why join now

The technical motion that closes our biggest deals currently lives in two founders' heads. You are the person who scales it, owns it, and builds the playbook that everyone after you runs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Remote, United States | Full time | Reports to the CEO

Compensation: $120K to $150K total compensation (base plus performance bonus) plus equity. This is our founding marketing hire.

You are being hired to fire the CEO from his second job.

Whippy grew to 1,000+ customers with almost no marketing team. Pipeline comes from founder led webinars, partner channels, referrals, and customer stories good enough that prospects quote them back to us. Right now the CEO personally writes the case studies, directs the website, organizes the events, and approves every asset, while the audiences we already own sit untouched: no sequences, no retargeting, no cross sell motion. Your job covers both halves of that problem. You codify the message, and you build the machine that ships it. Then you own a pipeline number the way an AE owns a quota.

One thing to know before you apply: this is a rare shape of role, deliberately. Most product marketers hand their messaging over a wall to someone else who distributes it. Most lifecycle marketers get handed messaging they didn't write. Here there is no wall. The person who writes the story builds the sequence it goes in. If you've spent your career on one side of that wall, this is not your job. If you've done both and hated the wall, keep reading.

Why Whippy

Whippy is the AI native platform for business communication: AI Voice Agents, AI Recruiting, messaging, VoIP, deep integrations, and our own workflow engine in one system. Our customers do not buy software that helps their employees do the work. They buy AI that does the work.

Our deepest market is staffing and HR, where we are the category leader, and new verticals are already opening behind it. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with named, public case studies showing customers saving $1M+ per year. The proof exists. The machine to distribute it does not. That is the problem you are hired to fix.

How we work

Bootstrapped and profitable, so revenue is the strategy, and marketing is measured in pipeline, not impressions. No task is above or beneath anyone here: you will interview customers yourself, write the first draft yourself, and build the sequence yourself. Use AI for leverage: research, repurposing, ops, the grunt work. Never for voice.

The mandate, in priority order

  1. Codify our messaging, then enforce it. Your first deliverable: extract our positioning from the founder's webinars, demos, and the language customers use in our case studies, and turn it into one messaging document. Positioning, product one liners, proof points, banned phrases, competitive framing against the tools we replace. The messaging exists today; it lives in the founder's head and a dozen slightly different pages. You make it one source of truth that everything you ship afterward draws from.

  2. Own email and lifecycle marketing end to end. This is where your messaging goes to work, immediately. Audiences we already own and never touch: a thousand customers who hold one product and have never heard about the other five, everyone who demoed and did not close, closed lost deals, and warm site traffic with no retargeting layer. You build the sequences, the drips, the new product announcement motion to the base and to dead pipeline, and the retargeting programs. Nothing here requires inventing demand. It requires finally talking to the people already in the building.

  3. Own marketing HubSpot. Today we run HubSpot as a CRM and nothing more: contacts are messy, marketing contacts are unmanaged, lifecycle stages are unused, and no lead has ever entered a nurture. You clean it up and make it the measurement backbone: contact hygiene and segmentation, marketing contact management, lifecycle stages, campaign tracking, and attribution from first visit through demo to close, working alongside our sales ops resource, so for the first time we can say which motion sourced which dollar.

  4. Build the proof engine. The CEO writes our case studies today, and prospects quote them back to us. You take that over: extract stories from webinar and call recordings, interview the customers, draft in our voice, get approvals, and arm every story as a page, a PDF, a one pager, and clips cut from recordings we already have. Then turn the library into enablement: battlecards against the tools we replace, per product one pagers built from our Solutions Engineer's technical documentation, and kits for the ATS partner reps who already recommend us inside their own demos and have never been given a single asset to do it with. Everything you write feeds everything you send.

  5. Turn events into campaigns, and manage our content writer. The CEO runs the webinars and the dinners; he is the talent. You make sure nothing he generates goes to waste: promotion and registration before, follow up sequences after, and extraction, so every webinar becomes case studies, clips, and campaigns within two weeks instead of sitting in a recording. And our blog and SEO writer reports to you: you set editorial priorities against the messaging doc, raise the bar, and turn one person patching articles into a content function.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: the messaging doc exists and the CEO signed it, you know our six products, three main competitors, and customer stories cold, marketing contacts in HubSpot are cleaned and segmented, and the first lifecycle sequence is live.

  • First 90 days: two new named case studies shipped and armed, cross sell and demo no close sequences producing measured pipeline, retargeting live, attribution reporting running in HubSpot from visit to close, and partner enablement kits in the hands of at least two ATS partner teams.

  • Year one: marketing is a predictable pipeline channel with its own number, every customer and dead deal in our database is in a motion, the proof library covers every product and vertical, and the CEO has not written a case study, built a sequence, directed a website page, or chased an event follow up in six months.

Who succeeds here

You have 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, and your career crossed the wall: you did hands on lifecycle, email, or growth work, and you did real product marketing, positioning, competitive, enablement, whether or not the titles said so. Most people like this come from companies under 100 people, where they were one of one or two marketers and did everything because nobody else would. That's who we want.

You can show us both kinds of receipts. Sequences you built with your own hands and what they produced. Full time | US Eastern hours | $2,000 to $3,000 USD per month total comp, paid monthly


Hi, I'm David, CEO and co-founder of Whippy. I'm hiring an Operations Associate to work directly with me and take over the layer of work that is keeping me from doing the things only a CEO can do.


Why I'm hiring

Whippy is a fast growing bootstrapped, profitable, and the category leader in AI communication for staffing, with over 1,000 customers and new industries opening behind it. We are hiring across sales, marketing, operations, and customer success right now, and the person finding and messaging every one of those candidates is me.

We recruit through my LinkedIn on purpose. A founder's message gets replies at many times the rate of a recruiter's. Your job is to take all of that off my plate, run it better than I do, and document it so well that someone else can run it after you. Then you move up to the next thing. I am hiring a Head of Operations in parallel, and you will be the first person on their team. If you are good, you will learn more about how a real business works in a year here than in three years anywhere else, because you will be inside the decisions, not reading about them.

Some things you'll do

The first 90 days are mostly recruiting:

• Build candidate lists in Sales Navigator and Juicebox against the ICPs I give you for each open role

• Message candidates from my LinkedIn account using templates written in my voice, and get good enough at it that I stop editing them

• Handle replies, route interested candidates to a screening call or a Loom, and flag anything you cannot answer

• Keep Ashby current, schedule interviews and reference calls, and chase interviewers for feedback

• Send me a weekly funnel: sent, accepted, replied, screened, hired

By day 90 you add the operations layer:

• Monitor Stripe for failed payments and overdue invoices, chase them to resolution, reconcile checks

• Process upgrades, downgrades, and churn across Stripe, HubSpot, and our internal tools off a checklist you help write

• Keep HubSpot records clean so what a customer signed, uses, and pays always match

• Handle Deel onboarding and offboarding steps, travel and dinner bookings, and the vendor list

Once that runs without reminders, you grow into partner administration, process documentation, and whatever the Head of Operations and I need figured out next. I will not pretend that is the day one job. It is earned by making the operational work disappear. But it is real, and the people who do this well become the operations team.

How we work

Bootstrapped and profitable, so revenue is the strategy. Our customers are East Coast, so we start early. No task is above or beneath anyone here, including me, and I still cold call. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work and verify every fact. Speed over polish. Results over activity. You will always know where you stand with me.

• Writing above all. You will be writing as me to VPs at American companies. It has to sound like a sharp person, not a template. This is the number one predictor of success in the role

• Organized to a fault. Nothing you own gets asked about twice

• Comfortable with a daily number. Outreach is a volume game run with care, and you like seeing the funnel move

• Curious, coachable, and low ego. You want feedback and you get better quickly

• Already using AI tools to work faster, and eager to automate your own work

• Judgment. Half this job is defined tasks. The other half is noticing what needs doing before anyone assigns it

• Ideally one to three years as an SDR, recruiting coordinator, or operations associate at a SaaS or tech company selling into the US. If your path is unconventional and you can explain why it makes you good at this, apply anyway

• Fluent written and spoken English, and able to work US Eastern hours

Experience with Stripe, HubSpot, or Ashby is a plus, not a requirement. I can teach tools. I cannot teach ownership.

You'll thrive here if...

• You get energy from a clean inbox and a moving funnel

• You would rather own a small thing completely than touch a big thing lightly

• You want to see how a company actually runs from the inside, and you are willing to do the unglamorous work to get that seat

• You are excited by a job that changes every month

This is not for you if

• You think outreach and billing are beneath you. They are week one, and they are how you earn everything after

• You need detailed instructions for every task

• You are looking for a job description that stays the same

About Whippy

Whippy is a communication, automation, and AI agent platform. You reach customers across calls, texts, and email at scale, with every conversation in one shared inbox. Replies get assigned to a teammate, handled by an AI agent, or carried forward by an automation, and the data flows back into your systems in the format you need. It cuts the repetitive work and frees teams for the human work that drives revenue.

We're industry agnostic, with our biggest wins in staffing, healthcare, and other in person businesses going through digital transformation. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with over 1,000 businesses using Whippy worldwide.

Whippy was founded in 2021 by me and our CTO, Jack Kennedy. Jack is an engineering machine and a marathon runner. I started BloomNation in 2011 after winning $27,205 in a poker tournament, grew it into a platform generating billions in sales for florists, then left to build something bigger with Jack.

Location

Remote across Latin America. Candidates in Buenos Aires who can work hybrid from our WeWork office in Vicente Lopez are strongly preferred, as we are building an in person team there. US Eastern hours required. Full English fluency required.

Compensation

$2,000 to $3,000 USD per month total ( base plus monthly performance bonus) depending on experience and location, with a WeWork membership included for Buenos Aires hires.

Hiring process

  1. You apply and I review it myself

  2. A 30 minute call with me

  3. A short take home: two outreach messages to sample candidate profiles written in my voice, and one billing scenario. You present it to me on a 30 minute call

  4. A 30 minute call with another key Whippy member

  5. Offer made

Head of Operations (Remote, LATAM or US)

Hi, I'm David, CEO and co-founder of Whippy. I'm hiring a Head of Operations to own everything in this company that is not selling, building product, or serving customers, and to build the team that runs it.

Why I'm hiring

Whippy is bootstrapped, profitable, and the category leader in AI communication for staffing, with over 1,000 customers and new industries opening behind it. We got here with a small team and a CEO who personally runs billing, contracts, payments, HubSpot, partner administration, recruiting, and most of the back office. That worked at 300 customers. My time needs to go to enterprise customers, new partnerships, new industries, and the hires that change the company. Everything else that routes through me today needs an owner.

The thesis for this role is simple. Learn each piece by doing it yourself. Document it so someone else can run it. Hire an Operations Associate to take it from you. Move up to the next piece. A year from now, the operational layer of this company should run without me being asked a question, and you should be the one running it.

What you will own

Five areas. You run all of them personally at first, then you hire and build the systems that run them after you.

  1. Revenue operations
    Billing, collections, and payments across Stripe and HubSpot. Quote to cash from signed order form to first invoice, including the automation project underway with our RevOps consultant. Sales operations for our AEs: pipeline and forecast reporting, commission calculation, deal desk support within guardrails I set, and the HubSpot setup our reps actually use. Account changes, meaning upgrades, downgrades, churn, and cross sells reflected correctly in every system.

  2. Contracts and vendors
    Contracts on our templates: order forms, MSAs, NDAs, partner agreements, with a short list of what comes to me. Vendor and SaaS management: renewals, usage audits, seat counts, and cost. Making sure what a customer signed, what they use, and what they pay always match.

  3. Partner administration
    Rev share calculation and payment for our ATS partners. Partner records, pipeline, and co marketing logistics in HubSpot. Over time, joining and then running our standing partner check ins once you know their business as well as I do.

  4. People and recruiting operations
    The recruiting process for every open role except final interviews, which stay with me and the hiring manager: sourcing, outreach, scheduling, pipeline in Ashby. Offers, Deel, onboarding and offboarding, PTO and expense policies, review cadence. Hiring and managing the Operations Associate who takes the first layer of this work from you.

  5. Systems, process, and compliance
    Documentation for every process you touch, written so a junior person can run it. The security and data packet enterprise customers ask for in vendor review, and SOC 2 readiness when we need it. Access control, offboarding security, and the tooling that keeps us from leaking money or data.

Once the five areas run without reminders, you move toward the work that sits closest to me: the operating cadence of the company, partner strategy and enablement, pricing and deal modeling, and research on the industries we expand into next.   • You have built an operations function from scratch, not inherited one. You know what billing, collections, contracts, and systems look like when they are done right because you have done it

  • You have managed people and built a process that other people then ran without you

  • You have sat across from an external party, a partner, a vendor, a customer, and handled something that mattered

  • You are willing to be hands on for the first six months. If you need a team on day one, this is not the role

  • Organized to a fault, clear in writing, and comfortable being direct with a founder

  • Fluent written and spoken English, and able to work US Eastern hours

  • Experience at a SaaS company, ideally one that sells to operators rather than to tech companies. Staffing or HR tech is a plus, not a requirement

This is not for you if

  • You think the operational work is beneath the title. It is the first six months and how you earn everything after

  • You want a defined scope that does not change. This role expands every quarter

  • You prefer to coordinate rather than own. I need someone who closes things, not someone who tracks them

About Whippy

Whippy is a communication, automation, and AI agent platform. You reach customers across calls, texts, and email at scale, with every conversation in one shared inbox. Replies get assigned to a teammate, handled by an AI agent, or carried forward by an automation, and the data flows back into your systems in the format you need. It cuts the repetitive work and frees teams for the human work that drives revenue.

We're industry agnostic, with our biggest wins in staffing, healthcare, and other in person businesses going through digital transformation. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with over 1,000 businesses using Whippy worldwide.

Whippy was founded in 2021 by me and our CTO, Jack Kennedy. Jack is an engineering machine and a marathon runner. I started BloomNation in 2011 after winning $27,205 in a poker tournament, grew it into a platform generating billions in sales for florists, then left to build something bigger with Jack.

Location

Remote, open to candidates in Latin America or the United States. Preference for people near where the company actually operates: Los Angeles or New York, where I spend most of my time, or Buenos Aires, where our CS team is based and we have a WeWork office. US Eastern hours (so yes if you are West Coast expect to be an early riser). Full English fluency required.

Hiring process

  1. You apply and I review it myself

  2. A 45 minute call with me

  3. A take home: I give you a real snapshot of how one process runs today, and you come back with how you would fix it, document it, and hand it off. You present it to me on a 45 minute call

  4. A 30 minute call with Jack, our CTO

  5. References, including someone who reported to you

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Latin America or the US. Our workday starts at 8am ET, so you'll need to work Eastern hours.

 

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses and more.

  1. A 30-minute call with me to get to know each other better.

  2. You'll receive a take-home assignment that assesses your technical and strategic skills, and you'll present it to me on a one-hour call. This is your chance to showcase your skills.

  3. A 30-minute call with our CEO, David.

This is one of those rare jobs with massive growth and learning opportunities: there's no bureaucracy here, and we're still early in building a world-class customer success team. You'll have a crucial role to play, and fresh ideas, feedback, and experimentation are always encouraged because we double down on wins and quickly pivot when ideas don't work out.

You'll work alongside our six-person customer success team and report directly to me. I'll provide the support, coaching, tools, and data to do the best work of your career here, plus the variable comp to get well rewarded when you deliver results.

Strategic as in you deeply understand your customers' pain points and always have a plan to solve them.   • Tie usage to business outcomes, and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.

  • Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

  • Turn wins into case studies, references, and testimonials that help sales win the next customer.

  • Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.

  • Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.

  • 2-5 years in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical consulting, or another technical customer-facing role at a SaaS company. If your path is unconventional and you can explain how it'll help you succeed in this role, I welcome you to apply.

  • Bonus points for experience in the staffing industry or with TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn.

  • Based in Latin America or the US, with fluent written and spoken English, and able to work Eastern hours (we start at 8am ET).

 

You'll thrive here if...

  • You're technical and love to build.

  • You're entrepreneurial. You treat your accounts like your own business and get energy from building from scratch.

  • You're a consultative problem solver. You dig into the why behind what a customer asks and recommend the right solution, even when it's not the one they came in asking for.

  • This sounds like fun to you: a customer wants to launch a complex, time-sensitive campaign across calls and texts, isn't sure how to structure it, and their team is stretched thin. You roll up your sleeves, map their goal to the product, and build it with them.

  • You thrive in a fast, evolving startup and you're excited to help build a customer success program from the ground up.

 

About Whippy

Whippy is a communication, automation, and AI agent platform. You reach customers across calls, texts, and email, at scale through personalized blasts and automated drips, with every message landing in one shared inbox. Replies get auto-assigned to a teammate, picked up by an AI agent, or carried forward by an automation. Once a conversation wraps, Whippy pushes the data you care about back into your systems in the exact format you need. It's true two-way dialogue on every channel that cuts the repetitive work and frees teams to focus on the human work that drives revenue, without adding headcount.

We're industry agnostic, with our biggest wins so far in staffing, healthcare, and other in-person businesses going through digital transformations. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with over 1,000 businesses using Whippy worldwide. In staffing alone, we've helped firms cut screening costs by 95% and save over a million dollars a year.

Whippy was founded in 2021 by CEO David Daneshgar and CTO Jack Kennedy. Jack is an engineering machine and a marathon runner. David started BloomNation in 2011 after winning $27,205 in a poker tournament, grew it into a platform generating billions in sales for florists, then left to build something bigger with Jack.

 

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Latin America or the US. Our workday starts at 8am ET, so you'll need to work Eastern hours.

 

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses and more.

 

Hiring Process

  1. A 30-minute call with me to get to know each other better.

  2. You'll receive a take-home assignment that assesses your technical and strategic skills, and you'll present it to me on a one-hour call. This is your chance to showcase your skills.

  3. A 30-minute call with our CEO, David.

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Remote, based in Brazil, working with US customers in overlapping hours
Full-time

Overview

Experience Required: 2+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, or a customer-facing engineering role
Education: Degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

About Whippy

Whippy is an AI-powered enterprise contact centre that automates real business workflows across voice, SMS, chat, and APIs.

We integrate with telephony providers, CRMs, ATS platforms, and internal enterprise systems to power AI agents that handle inbound calls, qualification flows, onboarding processes, support queries, and operational tasks.

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will embed directly into enterprise deployments and own the technical delivery of integrations between Whippy and customer systems.

You will operate at the intersection of APIs, telephony, databases, and AI workflows. You will design and ship production-grade systems, debug live issues, and convert customer-specific requirements into reusable platform capabilities.

This is a high-ownership role. You will work closely with customers, product, and core engineering to ensure deployments are robust, scalable, and repeatable.

What You’ll Do

• Own end-to-end delivery of production integrations across CRM, ATS, telephony, and internal systems
• Design and implement reliable data flows between Whippy and external platforms
• Handle authentication, rate limits, retries, and failure modes in distributed systems
• Debug and resolve non-trivial production issues across webhooks, async workflows, and external APIs
• Improve logging, monitoring, and observability of deployment pipelines
• Translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical designs
• Identify repeated patterns and convert one-off implementations into reusable connectors or internal tooling
• Collaborate with product and engineering to push field learnings back into the platform

What We’re Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting
• Strong backend fundamentals and comfort working with APIs and relational databases such as Postgres
• Experience integrating third-party systems or working with external APIs in production
• Understanding of distributed systems concepts such as idempotency, retries, async processing, and error handling
• Experience debugging production systems under time pressure
• Clear, structured communicator able to explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ownership mindset and comfort operating with ambiguity

Nice to Have

• Experience with telephony, event-driven systems, or webhook-based architectures
• Exposure to AI workflows, automation systems, or LLM integrations
• Experience working directly with enterprise customers, e.g in consulting, banking or equivalent

What Success Looks Like

Within 90 days, you will:

• Own at least one enterprise deployment end-to-end
• Resolve a meaningful production issue independently
• Ship at least one reusable improvement that reduces future deployment effort
• Demonstrate strong judgment around scope, trade-offs, and customer impact
